package tracepack_test

// Generator of the merge_minor0_v040 golden fixture: a merge of two format 1.0 (minor 0) segments
// by the released tracepack v0.4.0 module, and the canonical export of its archive.
//
// It runs inside the tracepack v0.4.0 module (git archive tracepack/v0.4.0 tracepack), offline:
//
//	cd tracepack && MERGE_GOLDEN_OUT=<dir> GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off \
//		go test -run '^TestMergeMinor0Golden$' -count=1 .
//
// It writes a.tpk and b.tpk, the inputs, written by v0.4.0's Writer with fixed ids and clock,
// archive.tpk, their merge by v0.4.0's Merge with fixed ids and clock, and export.jsonl, the archive's export.
//
// The inputs are segments of one capture in one UTC hour, under a classifier and a max_frame_len:
// a holds seqs 0 to 5, b seqs 4 to 9, in blocks of two records,
// so the overlapping blocks are resolved and every block is then coalesced, under the default options;
// the records are S1F1 and S6F11 data frames, an annotation note at seq 7 and a start boundary at seq 0.

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/arloliu/go-secs/tracepack"
)

// goldenHour is 2026-09-21T14:00:00Z in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.
const goldenHour int64 = 1_789_999_200_000_000_000

var (
	goldenCapture = tracepack.UUID{0xC0, 0x40, 0x01}
	goldenNow     = time.Unix(0, goldenHour+int64(30*time.Minute)).UTC()
)

// goldenFrame returns the HSMS data frame of stream s and function f with message text text.
func goldenFrame(s, f byte, text []byte) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, 14, 14+len(text))
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(b, uint32(10+len(text)))
	b[5], b[6], b[7], b[13] = 1, 0x80|s, f, 9

	return append(b, text...)
}

// goldenRecord returns the record of seq of the golden capture.
func goldenRecord(t *testing.T, seq uint64) tracepack.Record {
	t.Helper()

	r := tracepack.Record{
		Seq: seq, TSUTCNs: goldenHour + int64(seq)*int64(time.Second), Epoch: 1,
		Kind: tracepack.KindData, Dir: tracepack.DirEquipmentToHost, Fidelity: tracepack.FidelityWireExact,
		DecodeStatus: tracepack.DecodeStatusOK,
	}
	switch {
	case seq == 0:
		ev := tracepack.TransportEvent{Event: tracepack.EventCaptureBoundary, BoundaryKind: new(tracepack.BoundaryKindStart)}
		payload, err := ev.MarshalBinary()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		r.Kind, r.Dir, r.Fidelity, r.DecodeStatus, r.Epoch = tracepack.KindTransportEvent, tracepack.DirLocal,
			tracepack.FidelityNotApplicable, tracepack.DecodeStatusNotApplicable, 0
		r.Quality = tracepack.QualityCaptureBoundary
		r.Payload = payload
	case seq == 7:
		r.Kind, r.Dir, r.Fidelity, r.DecodeStatus = tracepack.KindAnnotation, tracepack.DirLocal,
			tracepack.FidelityNotApplicable, tracepack.DecodeStatusNotApplicable
		payload, err := (&tracepack.Annotation{AnnotationKind: tracepack.AnnotationKindNote, Text: new("operator note")}).MarshalBinary()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		r.Payload = payload
	case seq%2 == 0:
		r.Payload = goldenFrame(6, 11, []byte{0x01, 0x02, 0xA9, 0x02, 0x00, byte(seq), 0x41, 0x03, 'E', 'V', 'T'})
	default:
		r.Payload = goldenFrame(1, 1, nil)
		r.Dir = tracepack.DirHostToEquipment
	}
	if r.Kind == tracepack.KindData {
		r.SetCapturedFieldValidity()
	}

	return r
}

// goldenSegment writes the segment id of seqs first to last, in blocks of two records.
func goldenSegment(t *testing.T, id tracepack.UUID, first, last uint64) []byte {
	t.Helper()

	m := &tracepack.PackMeta{
		ToolID: "tool/golden", Transport: tracepack.TransportHSMSSS, CaptureMethod: tracepack.CaptureMethodRawStream,
		Vantage: tracepack.VantageHost, Recorder: "recorder/1", Writer: "writer/1", TimeSource: tracepack.TimeSourceGenerator,
		Classifiers: []string{"go-secs/golden"}, MaxFrameLens: []uint64{1 << 20},
		PackRole: tracepack.PackRoleSegment, ScopeGeneration: new(uint64(0)),
		PeriodStart: goldenHour, PeriodEnd: goldenHour + int64(time.Hour), SeqStart: first,
	}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	w, err := tracepack.NewWriter(&buf, tracepack.WriterOptions{
		Meta: m, PackID: id, CaptureID: goldenCapture, Now: func() time.Time { return goldenNow },
		Facts: tracepack.PackFacts{AnyClassified: true},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for seq := first; seq <= last; seq++ {
		r := goldenRecord(t, seq)
		require.NoError(t, w.Append(&r))
		if (seq-first)%2 == 1 {
			require.NoError(t, w.Flush())
		}
	}
	_, err = w.Close()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	return buf.Bytes()
}

func TestMergeMinor0Golden(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("MERGE_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("MERGE_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}

	a := goldenSegment(t, tracepack.UUID{0x5E, 0x0A}, 0, 5)
	b := goldenSegment(t, tracepack.UUID{0x5E, 0x0B}, 4, 9)
	var archive bytes.Buffer
	_, err := tracepack.Merge(t.Context(), &archive, []tracepack.MergeInput{
		{ReaderAt: bytes.NewReader(a), Size: int64(len(a))},
		{ReaderAt: bytes.NewReader(b), Size: int64(len(b))},
	}, tracepack.MergeOptions{
		Writer: "merger/golden", ScopeGeneration: 1, PublisherEpoch: 1,
		ReplacementSetID: tracepack.UUID{0x5E, 0x75}, PackID: tracepack.UUID{0xA4, 0xC1},
		Now: func() time.Time { return goldenNow }, OnConflict: func(tracepack.Conflict) { t.Fatal("conflict") },
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	r, err := tracepack.Open(t.Context(), bytes.NewReader(archive.Bytes()), int64(archive.Len()), tracepack.ReaderOptions{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var export bytes.Buffer
	_, err = tracepack.ExportJSONL(t.Context(), r, &export)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for name, data := range map[string][]byte{
		"a.tpk": a, "b.tpk": b, "archive.tpk": archive.Bytes(), "export.jsonl": export.Bytes(),
	} {
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), data, 0o644))
	}
}
